description: The package version is duplicated: pyproject.toml [project].version and tether/__init__.py __version__. The __init__ value is surfaced by 'tether --version' (via cli.py version_option) and used by run-smoke.sh as the wheel-stamp base; the pyproject value is what the built wheel reports. Both currently hold 0.1.0 and must be bumped together: a mismatch silently makes 'tether --version' disagree with the built/installed package version, and no test catches it.
